name: None
notes: No filter applies to this field.

name: Default
notes: Let the system decide the right filter for the field.

name: LookupFilter
notes: Drop Down control Filter to select a lookup field.

name: ValueStringFilter
notes: Filters a string field using wild cards * in the query.

name: ValueNumberFilter
notes: Filters a number field using the exact value of the field in the query.

name: RangeDateFilter
notes: Range filter for a field of DateTime data type.

name: RangeNumberFilter
notes: Range filter for a field of Numeric data type.
